note: כפתר records the consonantal stem of the gentilic.
summary: כַּפְתֹּרִים names the people of Caphtor. Genesis counts them among the descendants of Mizraim, and Deuteronomy describes them as coming from Caphtor.

senses.definition: A people from Caphtor whom Genesis counts among the descendants of Mizraim.

evidence.note: The final וְאֶת introduces the Caphtorim as the last people in the list governed by יָלַד, with Mizraim as its subject.
The phrase כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתּוֹר identifies the people by the place from which they came.
